result.instructions: Tools for Bria, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Generate a 16:9 product photo of a red ceramic mug on a light wooden table."; "Remove the background from this product image URL and give me the transparent PNG."; "Check whether the image I generated earlier has finished, and show me its URL.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bria data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bria_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bria_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bria_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bria_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bria_generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Bria's licensed visual model. Starts an async job and returns request_id and status_url: poll bria_get_status until status is COMPLETED, then read result.image_url. Each call uses credits on the account's plan (API access needs a paid plan). Bria API: POST /v2/image/generate.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

tools.name: bria_get_status
tools.title: Get a job status
tools.description: Get the progress and result of an async Bria job by request_id (from bria_generate_image or bria_remove_background). When status is COMPLETED, result holds the output, such as result.image_url. Bria API: GET /v2/status/{request_id}.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by a Bria job call.

tools.name: bria_remove_background
tools.title: Remove an image background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image and return a transparent cut-out as an async job (poll bria_get_status for result.image_url). The image is a public URL or a base64 string (JPEG, PNG or WEBP). Each call uses credits on the account's plan. Bria API: POST /v2/image/edit/remove_background.

image.description: Public image URL, or a base64-encoded image (JPEG, PNG or WEBP).

model.description: Background removal model (default RMBG2, the faster one).

preserve_alpha.description: Keep the input's transparency where it exists.
